summary: End-to-end verified the new 'Convert Sell-Form Lead to Property' flow on Admin Leads. Backend suite (9/9) and full UI walkthrough (create sell + contact leads via captcha, login, verify Convert button visibility, open PropertyModal, verify all prefills, save, verify status=converted, view-property link with target=_blank and /property/<id>, converted-filter retention, convert-button hidden post-conversion). All existing regression suites (46 tests) still pass. Cleanup of test data confirmed via bulk API DELETE (51 residual TEST_ leads/properties removed).

integration_issues.flow: PropertyModal open from Convert button — LocationPicker city/suburb prefill
integration_issues.issue: MINOR/INTERMITTENT: When Convert modal opens immediately after page load (before LocationPicker has finished fetching cities/suburbs for the pre-filled province), the city (Port Moresby) and suburb (Boroko) <select> elements briefly display '-- Select a city --' and 'Pick a city first' because their option lists are populated asynchronously and the assigned value has no matching <option> yet. A ~1.5s wait resolves it. Users manually opening the modal are unlikely to hit it, but automated/quick clicks may see empty selects and Save without the city/suburb. Suggest LocationPicker either (a) prefetch all provinces+cities+suburbs into a memoized store at admin-shell mount, or (b) re-sync selected value after options load.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Address the LocationPicker race condition described above so the Convert modal's city/suburb prefills reliably on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx buildPropertyDraftFromLead uses `Number(p.price) || 0` — 0 sneaks in silently if the seller submitted price=0/null. Consider warning admin in the modal, or leaving price blank so admin must set it.

Leads.jsx saveConverted has no loading/disabled state on the Save button while POST /properties + PUT /leads/{id} are in-flight — a rage-click will fire two property creations. Add a guard (e.g., setSaving state or disable data-testid='prop-save').

Leads.jsx saveConverted: if property POST succeeds but lead PUT fails (network blip), the property is created without the lead being marked converted — orphaned data. Consider a) do lead update inside try/catch with rollback DELETE /properties/{id}, or b) surface a clearer partial-failure toast.
seed_data_creation: Test leads with TEST/TESTSeller prefix created via /api/public/leads + captcha. All cleaned up after run (51 residuals also purged).
